references.text: Goat hair is mentioned as one of the materials to be gathered for the sanctuary, later used to make the tent curtains.
The preceding verses describe the inner curtains of fine linen, while the goat hair curtains in verse 7 were to cover over these.
The women spun goat hair with their skill for use in the tabernacle, fulfilling this command.
This verse describes the actual execution of the command to make eleven tent curtains of goat hair to cover the tabernacle.
The Gershonites were given responsibility for carrying the tabernacle curtains, including the covering of goat hair.
Explains the practical function of the extra length of the goat hair coverings that covered the sides of the tabernacle.
